profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the financial services industry. Skilled in Java Microservices, Continuous Integration, and Web Application Development. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) focused in Computer Science from Michigan Technological University.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
# 2025 / 2026
- Migrated Legacy Transaction System to GraphQL Implementation, creating solution to allow for on-the-fly comparison between fields, identified key pain points, and completed migration with no user impact.
- Provided architecture support to higher level engineers and leadership around the Transactions domain for integration and migration of Discover Financial Systems. Assisting in triaging critical issues through thorough investigation of legacy and modern transaction systems.

# 2023 / 2024 
- Onboarded and upskilled resources on mission critical systems within tight timeframe to ensure system stability and continuity of service and support.
- Led migration of legacy systems to modern caching mechanism to remediate security concerns and remove dependencies in legacy monolithic systems, enabling migration to modern microservices architecture.
- Ran comprehensive performance tests to ensure site reliability and ground changes to underlying caching mechanism. Presented results to senior leadership in order to achieve stakeholder buy-in.
- Researched, led, and implemented critical production fixes for partner products and resources, enabling the business to meet timelines.
- Acted as Product Owner, Tech Lead, and Scrum Master, filling in gaps as needed.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Supported and enhanced web-facing core business critical applications, including Card Customer Service, and Card Transaction Services, allowing for customer servicing of credit cards via capitalone.com
• Led design, implementation, and support displaying of reward point earn per transaction for Savor product in web, iOS, and Android applications driving increased customer engagement across platforms.
• Implemented asynchronous back-end call flow to sub-systems using Hystrix and Feign Java libraries allowing for increased system resiliency.
• Coordinated with web, iOS, and Android application teams to audit and consolidate data fields across the platforms to deliver a consistent developer and customer experience.
• Remediated application security vulnerability by contributing to inner-source library allowing for immediate compliance with corporate security standards for 200+ teams.
• Researched and created comprehensive documentation on decoupling features from monolithic code base, enabling teams to begin work on deconstruction and optimization of features from the legacy platform.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Supported and enhanced core business critical applications including Credit Card Accounts, Credit Card Transactions, and Message Queue Integration Service, each service responsible for over two thousand transactions per second.
• Mentored junior developers on modern engineering practices, including common REST design principals, testing frameworks, graceful failure and service degradation.
• Served as API Coach for entire line of business, ensuring adherence to proper REST design principals and common API contract across the enterprise.
• Assumed technical lead and main coordinator on multiple high-impact production war rooms and conference bridges, coordinating with business leadership, Amazon Web Services Technical Account Manager, and engineering teams.
• Designed fault-tolerant always-on resiliency pattern for Credit Card Transactions allowing for graceful failure and service degradation.
• Rewrote Credit Card Accounts to use modern framework and libraries, simplifying logic, removing tech debt, increasing code coverage, creating automatic integration tests, enabling caching to reduce response time to sub 100 milliseconds, and saving millions of calls to external system of record.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
During my time at Jackson National Life, I have been responsible for developing a variety of microservices using Java. Specifically, we have used JavaEE to deploy custom microservices using Resteasy and Jersey implementations of the JAX-RS 2.0 specification. In breaking our monolithic application down to easily consumable microservices, we moved from a waterfall software development methodology to a more agile process. These RESTful services allow for easy feature addition as well as allowing for granular abstraction. Utilizing Apache’s HttpClient to open these webservices to other developers, we have fostered an easily accessible ecosystem for developers to interact with. 

For microservices to be of use to business users, as well as the company, I developed front-end single-page web-apps using AngularJS 1.5. These user interfaces allowed business users, as well as other developers, access to crucial information such as build quality metrics, deployment information, and library auditing information. Having this information readily at hand has allowed for my company to enhance its unit test code coverage, conduct ad-hoc security audits and fix production-halting bugs. 

As part of Jack’s Continuous Quality team, I was responsible for developing and implementing a continuous integration environment by writing an event server with hooks into Jenkins, BitBucket, Jira, Artifactory, Automic, and SonarQube. This solution was responsible for running code-coverage metrics automatically on pull requests using a Groovy Jenkins plugin, as well as custom plugins developed for the Atlassian stack.

positions.title: Computer Science Teaching Assistant
positions.description: I was a teaching assistant to the Introductory Computer Science Lab Section. I was responsible for helping beginning Computer Science majors work through their lab assignments, administer quizzes and tests, answer any questions they had, and even assist in code debugging.
